title: Joining Safe Computation Segments
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean work-tape symbols, let $a$ be a state, and let $c,d,f$ be configurations on the same input. Suppose that after $u$ steps from $c$ the machine reaches $d$, and that during steps $0$ through $u$ its state is never $a$. Suppose also that after $v$ steps from $d$ it reaches $f$, and during steps $0$ through $v$ its state is never $a$. Then after $u+v$ steps from $c$ it reaches $f$, and its state is never $a$ during any step from $0$ through $u+v$.
hypotheses_covered: A distinguished state and three configurations on the same input
The run from the first configuration reaches the second after u steps
The first segment avoids the distinguished state at every step from 0 through u
The run from the second configuration reaches the third after v steps
The second segment avoids the distinguished state at every step from 0 through v
